notes: The supplied when on ἀσθενοῦσαν is a rule 7 helper on the participle, a participle being exactly the token rule 86 names as carrying subordination; the supplied subject and copula ride with it and the head is weak.
The article before συνείδησιν is unrepresented because the genitive αὐτῶν takes the English possessive, and αὐτῶν is free to take it (rules 20, 76).
